title: Other Insurer's Daily Payment for Continued-Stay Days at Issue: Appeals and Grievances Decision Table
content:
**Appeals and Grievances — other insurer's daily payment for the days at issue: decision table**

For an Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration taken on a denied continued-stay request for an inpatient mental health stay.

The other insurer's daily payment used for the days at issue is taken as follows: where other health insurance is on file for the patient and the stay's paid day lines show the other insurer's payments, it is their total divided by the stay's paid covered days; where other health insurance is on file, the stay's lines show none and the earlier admission's lines show one, it is that admission's other-insurer total divided by its covered days; in every other case it is zero; each is rounded to the cent.

Other health insurance is on file when the patient's active TRICARE Select enrollment shows it. The stay's paid day lines are the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines with the line outcome paid, from the facility of the stay's authorization, whose service date is the authorization's first valid day (the admission). The earlier admission is the admission under the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization at the same facility with status expired and the latest first valid day, as shown in Referrals and Authorizations; its first valid day is the admission date, and its paid lines are the patient's paid TRICARE Select lines from that facility with that service date. A line shows the other insurer's payment when the amount other health insurance paid first on it is above zero.

| Other health insurance on file | Stay's paid day lines show payments | Earlier admission's lines show a payment | Daily payment used |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | any | stay's other-insurer total per paid covered day |
| yes | no | yes | earlier admission's other-insurer total per covered day |
| yes | no | no | zero |
| no | any | any | zero |

Hypothetical: the stay's paid day lines show other-insurer payments totalling 400.00 over 8 covered days, so 50.00 a day. Had they shown none while the earlier admission's lines showed 300.00 over 5 days, the daily payment would be 60.00.
